style_bible.floor_plan_assumption: 同一个客餐厅一体大横厅，玄关、电视墙、沙发、餐桌、餐边柜和落地窗在同一住宅内。
style_bible.fixed_furniture_layout: 电视墙在长边，沙发正对电视墙，餐桌位于沙发后方，餐边柜靠近餐区。
style_bible.fixed_tv_wall: 暖灰岩板电视墙，深灰门墙柜一体柜体，隐藏灯带。
style_bible.fixed_cabinet_material: 深灰哑光柜门、暖木饰面、香槟金属细节。
style_bible.fixed_light_temperature: 3000K 暖色隐藏灯带，柔和窗光。
style_bible.fixed_camera_path: 玄关柜体入场，客厅打开，餐厨横移，柜体近景，材质灯光收尾。
style_bible.negative_prompt: different room, different house, inconsistent TV wall, inconsistent sofa, inconsistent dining table, changing floor material, changing cabinet color, harsh light, over saturated, cartoon, text, watermark

clips.label: 玄关门墙柜一体入场
clips.prompt: Camera begins beside the integrated entry wall cabinet and slowly enters the same open-plan living-dining room.

clips.label: 客厅空间打开
clips.prompt: Camera slowly moves forward into the same living room, revealing the fixed TV wall, sofa and floor-to-ceiling window.

clips.label: 餐厨横移漫游
clips.prompt: Camera slides laterally from the same sofa area toward the dining table and sideboard, keeping the same floor, cabinet and lighting language.

clips.label: 柜体系统近景
clips.prompt: Camera glides along a matching tall cabinet system and built-in storage wall, preserving the same warm grey cabinet material and LED lighting.

clips.label: 材质灯光收尾
clips.prompt: Slow cinematic close-up along the same wood veneer, stone texture, hidden LED strip and precise cabinet gaps, then settles on a clean cabinet wall.
